prompt: Under what condition can the battery last up to eight hours?
promptZh: 在什麼條件下電池最長可用八小時？

options.text: When the fan is at its highest speed
options.whyZh: 正式簡介只在最低速條件下標示最長續航八小時，並未對最高速作出同樣的說明。

options.text: When the lowest speed is selected
options.whyZh: 正式簡介清楚限定最低速。

options.text: When the middle speed is selected
options.whyZh: 正式簡介的八小時續航以最低速為條件，不是中速。

options.text: At any speed, as long as the battery is fully charged
options.zh: 充飽電後，任何風速皆可
options.whyZh: 這是電子報草稿的錯誤說法；正式簡介沒有說各風速都能達到八小時。

explanationZh: 正式簡介清楚限定最低速。
evidence: up to eight hours of operation at the lowest speed
